Innate Abilities

blocks.t: Leadership: When an allied Avenger within 3 of Cap makes a Throw or a Shield Bash superpower, it may spend 1 power to re-roll one die.

blocks.t: Once per activation, Captain America may spend 1 power to gain Stalwart (ignore conditions) until the end of the turn.

blocks.t: Physical superpower. Target a character within 3 and within line of sight: roll 5 attack dice; a crit also Staggers the target.
